description: "Rollo in Scotland" by Jacob Abbott is a fictional travel narrative written in the mid-19th century. The story revolves around a young boy, Rollo, who embarks on a fortnight-long journey to Scotland with his uncle George and encounters various adventures, including meeting a new friend and observing significant sites along the way.
